# Strategic Hypothesis Template

| Element | Entry |
|---|---|
| Observation | [Observation being explained] |
| Hypothesis | [Plausible explanation] |
| Frame | [Problem frame] |
| Mechanism | [How the pattern is produced] |
| Strategic implication | [What this would imply for action] |
| Expected evidence | [What should appear if true] |
| Disconfirming evidence | [What would weaken it] |
| Commitment level | [Monitor / research / prototype / pilot / scale / archive] |
| Revision trigger | [What would revise or reopen it] |
